issue.title: Unable to access IMU data on terminal using MAVSDK
issue.body: I am not able to access IMU data of pixhawk over USB. I am able to access the data using MAVROS but not using the telemetry class provided in mavsdk.

comments.body: Can you elaborate a bit? What did you try exactly? How did you setup mavsdk, and what functions did you call?
So you managed to create a connection to the drone? Does something else work, like arming and taking off, for instance?
I connected the pixhawk to my PC over USB. I was not able to arm it. But I only wanted to access the IMU data.

> But I only wanted to access the IMU data.

Ok, but that's interesting information. If nothing works, then it is maybe not an issue specific to the IMU data :sweat_smile:.

Can you show me the output of MAVSDK when you connect it to the pixhawk? Also, does MAVSDK work with SITL for you?

![px4_](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43798160/64992219-11458f00-d8f1-11e9-9be2-7a4b87089331.jpg)
This is the output of mavros(px4.launch). I have not tried mavsdk on the sitl yet.
I trust you when you say that it works with MAVROS. I want to see the output of MAVSDK in order to help you understand what is going wrong :+1:
@deepak-1530 by the way, you can copy console output using Ctrl+Shift+C. It makes it much more readable (and searchable).

![Screenshot from 2019-09-17 20-45-31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43798160/65133304-02112f00-da20-11e9-8300-d6dd18024608.png)
This is the MAVSDK example code output. I just displayed the acceleration data

@deepak-1530:

What code are you using to print the accel values?

Hmm so you create an `IMUReadingNED` object, and then print its value. That object was initialized with zeros as default values, which is what you're printing.

Isn't [void imu_reading_ned_async(imu_reading_ned_callback_t callback);](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/develop/src/plugins/telemetry/include/plugins/telemetry/telemetry.h#L913) what you want?
